::: {.event-facts}
[1 day]{.event-fact} [14 PhD presentations]{.event-fact} [7 universities]{.event-fact}
:::

:::{.justify}
The network's first workshop dedicated to PhD students gave the floor entirely to early-career researchers. Fourteen PhD candidates — two from each of the seven participating universities in Amsterdam, Groningen, Maastricht, Nijmegen, Tilburg, Utrecht and Wageningen — presented their work in 25-minute slots over a single day at Utrecht University, and the day ended with dinner.

Child marriage and intimate partner violence, vulnerability within institutions, attitudes towards refugees, pensions and old-age support, crop insurance, parental migration, soft skills in school, Covid-19 and economic mobility, foreign aid, seed access and nutrition, social media and gender norms, and the aftermath of war were among the topics.
:::

### Programme

::: {.programme}

#### Friday 10 November

- **Albena Sotirova**, Amsterdam [Child Marriage Around the World: Evidence from Repeated Cross-sectional Data]{.talk-title}
- **Anne Lieke Ebbers**, Nijmegen [Child Marriage, The Law and Contraceptive Use in Sub-Saharan Africa]{.talk-title}
- **Anouk van Veldhoven**, Utrecht [Interventions that Disrupt the Peace: Intimate Partner Violence when Targeting Men, Women or Both]{.talk-title}
- **Sueda Evirgen**, Tilburg [Vulnerability within Institutions: An Economic Framework]{.talk-title}
- **Tobias Hillenbrand**, Maastricht [Rather Unsafe or Sorry? The Role of Humanitarian Concern and Threat Perceptions in Shaping Solidarity Towards Refugees]{.talk-title}
- **Frederick Amon-Armah**, Groningen [Do Pension Savings by Smallholder Farmers in Africa Depend on Old-Age Support of their Children?]{.talk-title}
- **Samyuktha Kannan**, Wageningen [The Effect of Premium Payment Timing and Window on Willingness-To-Pay and Uptake of Crop Insurance]{.talk-title}
- **Emily Häntschel**, Nijmegen [The Effects of Parental Migration on Educational and Child Labour Outcomes for Children Left Behind: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis]{.talk-title}
- **Anaya Dam**, Utrecht [Can Teaching Soft Skills Improve Academic Outcomes? Evidence from a Goal-Setting Curriculum]{.talk-title}
- **Gerton Rongen**, Amsterdam [Effects of Covid-19 on Economic Mobility in Malaysia]{.talk-title}
- **Calumn Hamilton**, Groningen [Foreign Aid and Structural Change]{.talk-title}
- **Lan Nguyen T.T.**, Wageningen [Linking Seed Accessibility to Nutrition in the Context of Ethnic Minority Groups in Northern Vietnam: An Application of Multi-level Structural Equation Model (MSEM)]{.talk-title}
- **Praachi Kumar**, Maastricht [Mind the App: Gender Norms and Social Media]{.talk-title}
- **Camilo Arias**, Tilburg (& Los Andes) [What to Expect when you are Expecting (War is Over)]{.talk-title}
